# Step 2. Helper functions

wrap24 <- function(x) {
  ((x %% 24) + 24) %% 24
}

wrap_angle <- function(x) {
  x %% (2 * pi)
}

circ_diff <- function(a, b) {
  (a - b + pi) %% (2 * pi) - pi
}

hour_to_rad <- function(x) {
  as.numeric(x) / 24 * 2 * pi
}

rad_to_hour <- function(x) {
  ((as.numeric(x) %% (2 * pi)) / (2 * pi)) * 24
}

sample_balanced_zt <- function(zt_points, n_total) {
  zt_rep <- rep(zt_points, length.out = n_total)
  sample(zt_rep, size = n_total, replace = FALSE)
}

make_gene_truth <- function(
  gene_names,
  seed_genes,
  n_genes_per_module = c(500, 500, 500, 500, 500, 500, 500, 500),
  phase_shift_hours = 3,
  delta_phase_tol_hours = 1.5,
  amp_log2fc_gain = 1.2,
  amp_log2fc_loss = -1.2,
  seed_amp_min = 0.6,
  seed_M_min = 1.2,
  seed_phase_jitter_hour = 0.4,
  mean_mu = 0.8,
  mean_sd = 1.0,
  amp_meanlog = -0.7,
  amp_sdlog = 0.45,
  disp_meanlog = -1.5,
  disp_sdlog = 0.4,
  seed = 42
) {
  set.seed(seed)

  G <- sum(n_genes_per_module)

  gene_names <- as.character(gene_names)
  seed_genes <- unique(as.character(seed_genes))
  seed_genes <- seed_genes[!is.na(seed_genes)]
  seed_genes <- seed_genes[nzchar(seed_genes)]

  gene_names <- gene_names[seq_len(G)]
  seed_idx <- which(gene_names %in% seed_genes)

  stopifnot(length(gene_names) == G)
  stopifnot(length(seed_idx) == length(seed_genes))
  stopifnot(!any(is.na(gene_names)))
  stopifnot(!any(duplicated(gene_names)))

  module <- rep(0:7, times = n_genes_per_module)
  module[seed_idx] <- 1

  phase_shift_rad <- phase_shift_hours / 24 * 2 * pi
  delta_phase_tol_rad <- delta_phase_tol_hours / 24 * 2 * pi

  M_g <- rnorm(G, mean = mean_mu, sd = mean_sd)
  A_base <- rlnorm(G, meanlog = amp_meanlog, sdlog = amp_sdlog)
  phi_base <- runif(G, 0, 2 * pi)
  alpha_g <- rlnorm(G, meanlog = disp_meanlog, sdlog = disp_sdlog)

  set.seed(seed + 100)
  seed_phase_hour <- seq(0, 24, length.out = length(seed_idx) + 1)
  seed_phase_hour <- seed_phase_hour[-length(seed_phase_hour)]
  seed_phase_hour <- wrap24(seed_phase_hour + rnorm(length(seed_idx), mean = 0, sd = seed_phase_jitter_hour))

  phi_base[seed_idx] <- hour_to_rad(seed_phase_hour)
  A_base[seed_idx] <- pmax(A_base[seed_idx], seed_amp_min)
  M_g[seed_idx] <- pmax(M_g[seed_idx], seed_M_min)

  A_cond_1 <- A_base
  A_cond_2 <- A_base
  phi_cond_1 <- phi_base
  phi_cond_2 <- phi_base

  idx0 <- which(module == 0)
  idx2 <- which(module == 2)
  idx3 <- which(module == 3)
  idx4 <- which(module == 4)
  idx5 <- which(module == 5)
  idx6 <- which(module == 6)
  idx7 <- which(module == 7)

  A_cond_1[idx0] <- 0
  A_cond_2[idx0] <- 0

  A_cond_1[idx2] <- 0
  A_cond_2[idx3] <- 0

  A_cond_2[idx4] <- A_base[idx4] * 2^amp_log2fc_gain
  A_cond_2[idx5] <- A_base[idx5] * 2^amp_log2fc_loss

  set.seed(seed + 200)
  phase_jitter4 <- runif(length(idx4), -0.5 * delta_phase_tol_rad, 0.5 * delta_phase_tol_rad)
  phase_jitter5 <- runif(length(idx5), -0.5 * delta_phase_tol_rad, 0.5 * delta_phase_tol_rad)

  phi_cond_2[idx4] <- wrap_angle(phi_base[idx4] + phase_jitter4)
  phi_cond_2[idx5] <- wrap_angle(phi_base[idx5] + phase_jitter5)
  phi_cond_2[idx6] <- wrap_angle(phi_base[idx6] - phase_shift_rad)
  phi_cond_2[idx7] <- wrap_angle(phi_base[idx7] + phase_shift_rad)

  delta_phase <- mapply(function(x, y) circ_diff(y, x), phi_cond_1, phi_cond_2)
  delta_amp_log2fc <- log2((A_cond_2 + 1e-8) / (A_cond_1 + 1e-8))

  gene_meta <- data.frame(
    gene = gene_names,
    module = module,
    is_seed_gene = gene_names %in% seed_genes,
    M = M_g,
    alpha = alpha_g,
    A_base = A_base,
    phi_base = phi_base,
    phi_base_hour = rad_to_hour(phi_base),
    A_cond_1 = A_cond_1,
    A_cond_2 = A_cond_2,
    phi_cond_1 = phi_cond_1,
    phi_cond_2 = phi_cond_2,
    phi_cond_1_hour = rad_to_hour(phi_cond_1),
    phi_cond_2_hour = rad_to_hour(phi_cond_2),
    delta_amp_log2fc = delta_amp_log2fc,
    delta_phase_rad = delta_phase,
    delta_phase_hour = delta_phase / (2 * pi) * 24
  )

  gene_meta$check_m4 <- with(
    gene_meta,
    module == 4 & delta_amp_log2fc > 1 & abs(delta_phase_hour) < delta_phase_tol_hours + 1e-8
  )

  gene_meta$check_m5 <- with(
    gene_meta,
    module == 5 & delta_amp_log2fc < -1 & abs(delta_phase_hour) < delta_phase_tol_hours + 1e-8
  )

  gene_meta$check_m6 <- with(
    gene_meta,
    module == 6 & abs(delta_phase_hour + phase_shift_hours) < 1e-6
  )

  gene_meta$check_m7 <- with(
    gene_meta,
    module == 7 & abs(delta_phase_hour - phase_shift_hours) < 1e-6
  )

  list(
    gene_meta = gene_meta,
    params = list(
      phase_shift_hours = phase_shift_hours,
      delta_phase_tol_hours = delta_phase_tol_hours,
      amp_log2fc_gain = amp_log2fc_gain,
      amp_log2fc_loss = amp_log2fc_loss,
      seed_amp_min = seed_amp_min,
      seed_M_min = seed_M_min,
      seed_phase_jitter_hour = seed_phase_jitter_hour
    )
  )
}

simulate_one_timepoint_dataset <- function(
  n_timepoint,
  gene_truth,
  n_cond_1 = 10000,
  n_cond_2 = 10000,
  sigma_t = 1.2,
  log_sf_sd = 0.45,
  dropout_b0 = 1.0,
  dropout_b1 = -0.8,
  p_alpha = 5,
  p_beta = 2,
  kappa_min = 3,
  kappa_max = 30,
  seed = 42,
  show_progress = TRUE
) {
  set.seed(seed)

  gene_meta <- gene_truth$gene_meta
  G <- nrow(gene_meta)
  N <- n_cond_1 + n_cond_2

  condition <- c(rep("cond_1", n_cond_1), rep("cond_2", n_cond_2))
  celltype <- rep("Celltype1", N)

  zt_points <- expected_zt_list[[as.character(n_timepoint)]]
  ZT_sym <- numeric(N)
  ZT_sym[condition == "cond_1"] <- sample_balanced_zt(zt_points, n_cond_1)
  ZT_sym[condition == "cond_2"] <- sample_balanced_zt(zt_points, n_cond_2)

  ZT_true <- wrap24(ZT_sym + rnorm(N, mean = 0, sd = sigma_t))
  theta_true <- hour_to_rad(ZT_true)

  p_cell <- rbeta(N, shape1 = p_alpha, shape2 = p_beta)
  kappa_i <- kappa_min + (kappa_max - kappa_min) * p_cell

  set.seed(seed + 100)
  theta_obs <- theta_true + rnorm(N, mean = 0, sd = 1 / sqrt(kappa_i))
  theta_obs <- wrap_angle(theta_obs)

  log_sf <- rnorm(N, mean = 0, sd = log_sf_sd)
  sf <- exp(log_sf)

  Y <- matrix(0, nrow = G, ncol = N)

  if (show_progress) pb_counts <- txtProgressBar(min = 0, max = G, style = 3)

  for (g in seq_len(G)) {
    amp_vec <- ifelse(condition == "cond_1", gene_meta$A_cond_1[g], gene_meta$A_cond_2[g])
    phi_vec <- ifelse(condition == "cond_1", gene_meta$phi_cond_1[g], gene_meta$phi_cond_2[g])

    log_mu <- gene_meta$M[g] + amp_vec * cos(theta_true - phi_vec) + log_sf
    mu <- exp(log_mu)

    pi_drop <- plogis(dropout_b0 + dropout_b1 * log(mu + 1))
    is_drop <- rbinom(N, size = 1, prob = pi_drop)
    counts <- rnbinom(N, mu = mu, size = 1 / gene_meta$alpha[g])
    counts[is_drop == 1] <- 0

    Y[g, ] <- counts

    if (show_progress) setTxtProgressBar(pb_counts, g)
  }

  if (show_progress) close(pb_counts)

  rownames(Y) <- gene_meta$gene
  colnames(Y) <- paste0("Cell", seq_len(N))

  cell_meta <- data.frame(
    cell = colnames(Y),
    condition = condition,
    group = condition,
    celltype = celltype,
    ZT_sym = as.numeric(ZT_sym),
    ZT_true = ZT_true,
    t_true = ZT_true,
    theta_rad = theta_true,
    theta_true = theta_true,
    theta_obs = theta_obs,
    p = p_cell,
    kappa = kappa_i,
    size_factor = sf,
    log_sf = log_sf
  )

  list(
    counts = Y,
    gene_meta = gene_meta,
    cell_meta = cell_meta,
    params = c(
      gene_truth$params,
      list(
        sigma_t = sigma_t,
        n_cond_1 = n_cond_1,
        n_cond_2 = n_cond_2
      )
    )
  )
}

make_truth_object <- function(sim_i, n_timepoint) {
  gene_meta <- sim_i$gene_meta

  list(
    genes = as.character(gene_meta$gene),
    celltypes = c("cond_1", "cond_2"),
    groups = c("cond_1", "cond_2"),
    modules = gene_meta$module,
    gene_meta = gene_meta,
    A_mat = cbind(
      cond_1 = gene_meta$A_cond_1,
      cond_2 = gene_meta$A_cond_2
    ),
    phi_mat = cbind(
      cond_1 = gene_meta$phi_cond_1,
      cond_2 = gene_meta$phi_cond_2
    ),
    M_vec = gene_meta$M,
    alpha_vec = gene_meta$alpha,
    params = sim_i$params,
    benchmark = list(
      benchmark = "timepoint_number",
      n_timepoint = n_timepoint,
      ZT_points = expected_zt_list[[as.character(n_timepoint)]],
      n_gene = nrow(gene_meta),
      n_cell = ncol(sim_i$counts),
      n_condition = 2,
      n_celltype = 1,
      truth_source = "shared_gene_truth_with_strong_default_seed_genes_and_continuous_cell_phase"
    )
  )
}

# Step 3. Generate shared gene-level truth

gene_truth <- make_gene_truth(
  gene_names = gene_use,
  seed_genes = seed27,
  n_genes_per_module = c(500, 500, 500, 500, 500, 500, 500, 500),
  phase_shift_hours = 3,
  delta_phase_tol_hours = 1.5,
  amp_log2fc_gain = 1.2,
  amp_log2fc_loss = -1.2,
  seed_amp_min = 0.6,
  seed_M_min = 1.2,
  seed_phase_jitter_hour = 0.4,
  mean_mu = 0.8,
  mean_sd = 1.0,
  amp_meanlog = -0.7,
  amp_sdlog = 0.45,
  disp_meanlog = -1.5,
  disp_sdlog = 0.4,
  seed = 42
)

gene_meta <- gene_truth$gene_meta

# Step 4. Check shared gene design

diag_seed <- gene_meta %>%
  filter(is_seed_gene) %>%
  summarise(
    n_seed = n(),
    n_seed_module1 = sum(module == 1),
    min_A_cond_1 = min(A_cond_1),
    min_A_cond_2 = min(A_cond_2),
    median_A_cond_1 = median(A_cond_1),
    median_A_cond_2 = median(A_cond_2),
    min_M = min(M),
    median_M = median(M),
    min_phi_hour = min(phi_base_hour),
    max_phi_hour = max(phi_base_hour)
  )

diag_amp <- gene_meta %>%
  summarise(
    n_gene = n(),
    n_seed = sum(is_seed_gene),
    n_module0 = sum(module == 0),
    median_A_cond_1 = median(A_cond_1),
    median_A_cond_2 = median(A_cond_2),
    pct_A_cond_1_lt_0.1 = mean(A_cond_1 < 0.1) * 100,
    pct_A_cond_2_lt_0.1 = mean(A_cond_2 < 0.1) * 100,
    pct_A_cond_1_gt_0.1 = mean(A_cond_1 > 0.1) * 100,
    pct_A_cond_2_gt_0.1 = mean(A_cond_2 > 0.1) * 100,
    pct_both_amp_gt_0.1 = mean(A_cond_1 > 0.1 & A_cond_2 > 0.1) * 100
  )

diag_module <- gene_meta %>%
  count(module, name = "n_gene")

diag_module_amp <- gene_meta %>%
  group_by(module) %>%
  summarise(
    n_gene = n(),
    n_seed = sum(is_seed_gene),
    median_A_cond_1 = median(A_cond_1),
    median_A_cond_2 = median(A_cond_2),
    pct_A_cond_1_gt_0.1 = mean(A_cond_1 > 0.1) * 100,
    pct_A_cond_2_gt_0.1 = mean(A_cond_2 > 0.1) * 100,
    median_delta_amp_log2fc = median(delta_amp_log2fc),
    median_delta_phase_hour = median(delta_phase_hour),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

diag_module_check <- gene_meta %>%
  summarise(
    m4_pass = sum(check_m4),
    m5_pass = sum(check_m5),
    m6_pass = sum(check_m6),
    m7_pass = sum(check_m7),
    n_m4 = sum(module == 4),
    n_m5 = sum(module == 5),
    n_m6 = sum(module == 6),
    n_m7 = sum(module == 7)
  )

print(diag_seed)
print(diag_amp)
print(diag_module)
print(diag_module_amp)
print(diag_module_check)

stopifnot(diag_seed$n_seed == 27)
stopifnot(diag_seed$n_seed_module1 == 27)
stopifnot(diag_seed$min_A_cond_1 >= 0.6)
stopifnot(diag_seed$min_A_cond_2 >= 0.6)
stopifnot(diag_seed$min_M >= 1.2)
stopifnot(diag_module_check$m4_pass == diag_module_check$n_m4)
stopifnot(diag_module_check$m5_pass == diag_module_check$n_m5)
stopifnot(diag_module_check$m6_pass == diag_module_check$n_m6)
stopifnot(diag_module_check$m7_pass == diag_module_check$n_m7)

# Step 5. Simulate each time-point dataset

record_all <- list()

for (n_timepoint in timepoint_vec) {
  message("Simulating n_timepoint = ", n_timepoint)

  sim_i <- simulate_one_timepoint_dataset(
    n_timepoint = n_timepoint,
    gene_truth = gene_truth,
    n_cond_1 = 10000,
    n_cond_2 = 10000,
    sigma_t = 1.2,
    log_sf_sd = 0.45,
    dropout_b0 = 1.0,
    dropout_b1 = -0.8,
    p_alpha = 5,
    p_beta = 2,
    kappa_min = 3,
    kappa_max = 30,
    seed = 42 + n_timepoint,
    show_progress = TRUE
  )

  counts <- sim_i$counts
  cell_meta <- sim_i$cell_meta

  stopifnot(
    nrow(counts) == 4000,
    ncol(counts) == 20000,
    identical(colnames(counts), cell_meta$cell),
    identical(sort(unique(cell_meta$ZT_sym)), expected_zt_list[[as.character(n_timepoint)]]),
    sum(cell_meta$condition == "cond_1") == 10000,
    sum(cell_meta$condition == "cond_2") == 10000,
    length(unique(cell_meta$celltype)) == 1,
    sum(seed27 %in% rownames(counts)) == 27,
    all(Matrix::rowSums(counts[seed27, , drop = FALSE]) > 0)
  )

  obj_i <- CreateSeuratObject(
    counts = counts,
    meta.data = cell_meta %>% tibble::column_to_rownames("cell")
  )

  DefaultAssay(obj_i) <- "RNA"

  truth_i <- make_truth_object(sim_i, n_timepoint)

  obj_file <- file.path(
    obj_dir,
    paste0("simulate_data_timepoint", n_timepoint, "_4000g_20000c.rds")
  )

  truth_file <- file.path(
    truth_dir,
    paste0("truth_params_timepoint", n_timepoint, "_4000g_20000c.rds")
  )

  sim_file <- file.path(
    out_dir,
    paste0("simulation_data_timepoint", n_timepoint, "_4000g_20000c.qs")
  )

  saveRDS(obj_i, obj_file)
  saveRDS(truth_i, truth_file)
  qsave(sim_i, sim_file)

  diag_zt <- cell_meta %>%
    count(condition, ZT_sym, name = "n_cell") %>%
    arrange(condition, ZT_sym)

  diag_cell <- cell_meta %>%
    summarise(
      n_cell = n(),
      n_cond_1 = sum(condition == "cond_1"),
      n_cond_2 = sum(condition == "cond_2"),
      n_celltype = n_distinct(celltype),
      n_ZT = n_distinct(ZT_sym),
      median_ZT_true = median(ZT_true),
      sd_ZT_true = sd(ZT_true),
      median_p = median(p),
      median_kappa = median(kappa),
      median_size_factor = median(size_factor)
    )

  seed_expr <- Matrix::rowSums(counts[seed27, , drop = FALSE])

  diag_seed_expr <- tibble(
    n_timepoint = n_timepoint,
    n_seed = length(seed_expr),
    min_seed_expr = min(seed_expr),
    median_seed_expr = median(seed_expr),
    mean_seed_expr = mean(seed_expr),
    max_seed_expr = max(seed_expr),
    n_seed_zero_expr = sum(seed_expr == 0)
  )

  print(diag_cell)
  print(diag_zt)
  print(table(cell_meta$condition, cell_meta$ZT_sym))
  print(diag_seed_expr)

  record_all[[as.character(n_timepoint)]] <- tibble(
    n_timepoint = n_timepoint,
    n_gene = nrow(obj_i),
    n_cell = ncol(obj_i),
    n_condition = length(unique(cell_meta$condition)),
    n_celltype = length(unique(cell_meta$celltype)),
    ZT_points = paste(expected_zt_list[[as.character(n_timepoint)]], collapse = ","),
    obj_file = obj_file,
    truth_file = truth_file,
    sim_file = sim_file,
    n_cond_1 = sum(cell_meta$condition == "cond_1"),
    n_cond_2 = sum(cell_meta$condition == "cond_2"),
    n_seed_in_count = sum(seed27 %in% rownames(counts)),
    n_seed_zero_expr = sum(seed_expr == 0),
    median_seed_expr = median(seed_expr)
  )

  message("Finished n_timepoint = ", n_timepoint)

  rm(sim_i, obj_i, truth_i, counts, cell_meta, seed_expr, diag_zt, diag_cell, diag_seed_expr)
  gc()
}

# Step 6. Save index and diagnostics

timepoint_index <- bind_rows(record_all) %>%
  arrange(desc(n_timepoint))

write_csv(
  timepoint_index,
  file.path(index_dir, "timepoint_sim_object_index.csv")
)

saveRDS(
  timepoint_index,
  file.path(index_dir, "timepoint_sim_object_index.rds")
)

print(timepoint_index)

write_csv(diag_seed, file.path(index_dir, "simulation_seed_gene_diagnostics.csv"))
write_csv(diag_amp, file.path(index_dir, "simulation_amp_diagnostics_shared_gene_truth.csv"))
write_csv(diag_module, file.path(index_dir, "simulation_module_diagnostics_shared_gene_truth.csv"))
write_csv(diag_module_amp, file.path(index_dir, "simulation_module_amp_diagnostics_shared_gene_truth.csv"))
write_csv(diag_module_check, file.path(index_dir, "simulation_module_check_shared_gene_truth.csv"))

message("Finished generating all time-point benchmark simulation objects.")
message("Object output: ", obj_dir)
message("Truth output: ", truth_dir)
